title: Rose with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x="47" y="60" width="6" height="30" rx="3" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <!-- leaf left -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="72" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#3cb371" transform="rotate(-25 38 72)"/>
  <!-- leaf right -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="78" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#228b22" transform="rotate(25 62 78)"/>
  <!-- stem leaf vein left -->
  <line x1="30" y1="74" x2="46" y2="70" stroke="#90ee90" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- petal back left -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="40" rx="16" ry="18" fill="#e05580" transform="rotate(-30 32 40)"/>
  <!-- petal back right -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="40" rx="16" ry="18" fill="#e05580" transform="rotate(30 68 40)"/>
  <!-- petal top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="28" rx="15" ry="16" fill="#ff6b95"/>
  <!-- petal middle left -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="48" rx="14" ry="14" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <!-- petal middle right -->
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="48" rx="14" ry="14" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <!-- petal bottom -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#e05580"/>
  <!-- face area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="16" ry="15" fill="#ffb3c6"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="42" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="42" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#ffe0e8"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#ffe0e8"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 50 Q50 58 58 50" stroke="#d6336c" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="49" r="3" fill="#ff85a1" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="49" r="3" fill="#ff85a1" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- little leaf at top -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="18" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#3cb371" transform="rotate(20 55 18)"/>
</svg>
